## 31 January 2008

## Circular to Management Companies of SFC-Authorised Real Estate Investment Trusts ('REITs')

## New Frequently Asked Questions

The  SFC  has  recently  updated  the  Frequently  Asked  Questions  (FAQs)  relating  to  real  estate investment trusts (REITs) on its website.

We would like to draw your attention to the new FAQs posted which clarify and provide practical guidance to the requirements relating to, among other things, the following matters with regards to SFC-authorised REITs:

- 'Top-up placings'
- Unit repurchases
- Secondary offerings
- Adoption of incentive plans
- Interim/annual reports and results announcements
- Valuation requirements
- Annual general meetings
- Format of accountants' reports

A  copy  of  these  new  FAQs  is  attached  for  your  reference.    Please  also  refer  to  the  separate circular  we  issued  on  even  date  setting  out  detailed  guidance  in  respect  of  on-market  unit repurchases by REITs.

The full version of the updated FAQs can be found on the SFC's website under 'Intermediaries, Licensing and Investment Products - Investment Products Related Matters - FAQs - Frequently Asked Questions Relating to Real Estate Investment Trusts'.

If you wish to clarify any aspects of the new FAQs, please contact the relevant team supervisor or case officer of the Investment Products Department.
